records.source: Pizza/Pizza! There's a reason pizza is a timeless culinary classic. You've got an artisan golden-brown crust, you've got a tangy, garlic-infused marinara sauce, and you're topping it all with a mouth-watering three-cheese blend. And we're just getting started! Let's throw some fresh pepper and tomato on the top. Oh, my!
records.translation: Pizza/Pizza! May dahilan kung bakit walang kupas na klasiko sa pagluluto ang pizza. May gawang-artisan kang ginintuang-kayumangging crust, maasim-asim na sarsang marinara na may bawang, at sa ibabaw nito'y pinaghalong tatlong kesong nakapaglalaway. Nagsisimula pa lang tayo! Maglagay tayo sa ibabaw ng sariwang sili at kamatis. Naku!

records.source: Hashbrowns/Hashbrowns! This one's simple, but that's a good thing! You'll just want to shred some potatoes, add a liberal amount of salt, and fry to perfection in your favorite high-heat oil. Sounds easy, right? Well, I've got some pointers that'll make your job a lot easier...
records.translation: Ginadgad na Patatas/Ginadgad na Patatas! Simple ito, pero mabuti iyon! Kudkurin lang ang ilang patatas, magdagdag ng maraming asin, at iprito nang perpekto sa paborito mong langis na angkop sa matinding init. Mukhang madali, hindi ba? May ilang payo ako upang mas mapadali ang trabaho mo...

records.source: Complete Breakfast/Complete Breakfast! Last week I taught you how to make hashbrowns. This week I'll show you how to combine them with other ingredients to create a hearty complete breakfast. This meal will really fill you up and give you the energy you need to get in a hard day's work.
records.translation: Kumpletong Almusal/Kumpletong Almusal! Noong nakaraang linggo, itinuro ko sa iyo kung paano gumawa ng ginadgad na patatas. Ngayong linggo, ipapakita ko kung paano ito isasama sa ibang sangkap upang gumawa ng nakabubusog na kumpletong almusal. Talagang bubusugin ka ng pagkaing ito at bibigyan ng lakas para sa isang araw ng puspusang trabaho.

records.source: Lucky Lunch/Lucky Lunch! An old legend has it that this meal is irresistible to spirits of luck and fortune. After consuming it, you're likely to attract a good spirit into your belly, where it will bless you with good fortune until the meal is digested! Sounds weird, huh? I can't say I believe it, but the meal is delicious nonetheless!
records.translation: Masuwerteng Tanghalian/Masuwerteng Tanghalian! Ayon sa isang lumang alamat, hindi ito kayang tanggihan ng mga espiritu ng suwerte at kapalaran. Pagkatapos mo itong kainin, malamang na makaakit ka ng mabuting espiritu sa tiyan mo, kung saan pagpapalain ka nito ng suwerte hanggang matunaw ang pagkain! Kakaiba, hindi ba? Hindi ko masasabing naniniwala ako, pero masarap pa rin ang pagkain!

records.source: Carp Surprise/Hey, ever have a bunch of carp laying around and no idea what to do with them? Yeah, me too. Well, I've devised a great solution to this all-too-common problem. I call it... Carp surprise. It's quite easy to make, but you'll need a lot of carp...
records.translation: Sorpresang Karpa/Uy, may tambak ka bang karpa at hindi mo alam kung ano ang gagawin sa mga iyon? Oo, ako rin. Nakaisip ako ng mahusay na solusyon sa napakakaraniwang problemang ito. Ang tawag ko rito ay... Sorpresang Karpa. Madali itong gawin, pero kakailanganin mo ng maraming karpa...

records.source: Maple Bar/Maple Bars! Ever notice how the maple bars are always first to disappear from the doughnut box? Perplexing, because your average maple bar tastes like a sweet hockey puck. Agree? Well, just wait until you try my recipe. You can really taste the forest in these bars. Okay, you're going to need real, quality maple syrup...
records.translation: Bar na Maple/Mga Bar na Maple! Napansin mo bang laging unang nauubos ang mga bar na maple sa kahon ng donut? Nakapagtataka, dahil lasang matamis na diskong pang-hockey ang karaniwang bar na maple. Sang-ayon ka? Hintayin mong matikman ang resipe ko. Talagang malalasahan mo ang gubat sa mga bar na ito. Sige, kakailanganin mo ng tunay at de-kalidad na arnibal ng maple...

records.source: Pink Cake/A viewer from Pelican Town wrote to me recently... let's see... Her name's Haley. She wrote, 'I tried your pink cake last time I was in Zuzu City and I fell in love with it. Could you share the recipe on your next episode?'. Well, why not? It's a marvelous cake. And you'll never guess the secret ingredient... melon!
records.translation: Kulay-Rosas na Keyk/May isang manonood mula sa Bayan ng Pelican na sumulat sa akin kamakailan... tingnan natin... Haley ang pangalan niya. Isinulat niya, “Natikman ko ang kulay-rosas mong keyk noong huli akong pumunta sa Lungsod ng Zuzu at nagustuhan ko iyon. Maaari mo bang ibahagi ang resipe sa susunod mong palabas?” Aba, bakit hindi? Napakagandang keyk nito. At hindi mo mahuhulaan ang lihim na sangkap... melon!

records.source: Roasted Hazelnuts/Roasted Hazelnuts! I've got a nice old hazelnut tree behind my house, and every year I invite the family over for a nut roasting party! Once we start roasting, it's inevitable that the neighbors will show up. That rich, nutty smell is irresistible. Now, here's the family recipe...
records.translation: Mga Inihaw na Hazelnut/Mga Inihaw na Hazelnut! May maganda at matandang puno ng hazelnut sa likod ng bahay ko, at taon-taon ay inaanyayahan ko ang pamilya para sa salu-salong pag-iihaw ng mani! Kapag nagsimula kaming mag-ihaw, tiyak na darating ang mga kapitbahay. Hindi kayang tanggihan ang masaganang amoy ng mani. Ngayon, narito ang resipe ng pamilya...

records.source: Fruit Salad/Fruit Salad! Here's a healthy and delicious treat to brighten up your day. The most important thing to remember is that you need ripe fruit. Forget the bland stuff they sell at the supermarket... I'm talking fresh-picked, juicy, bursting-with-flavor fruit. Okay, now watch closely...
records.translation: Ensaladang Prutas/Ensaladang Prutas! Narito ang masustansiya at masarap na pagkaing magpapasigla sa araw mo. Ang pinakamahalagang tandaan ay kailangan mo ng hinog na prutas. Kalimutan ang matatabang ibinebenta sa supermarket... Ang ibig kong sabihin ay bagong-pitas, makatas, at punô ng lasa. Sige, tingnang mabuti...

records.source: Blackberry Cobbler/Blackberry Cobbler! This one always reminds me of Stardew Valley. There's a few days in fall where the valley is overflowing with the most delicious blackberries I've ever tasted. If you can get your hands on some, I'd highly recommend them for this simple cobbler.
records.translation: Cobbler na Blackberry/Cobbler na Blackberry! Lagi nitong ipinapaalala sa akin ang Stardew Valley. May ilang araw sa taglagas na umaapaw ang lambak sa pinakamasarap na blackberry na natikman ko. Kung makakakuha ka ng ilan, lubos kong inirerekomenda ang mga iyon para sa simpleng cobbler na ito.

records.source: Crab Cakes/Crab Cakes! Crab meat is very flimsy on its own, but mixing it with bread crumbs and egg is a great way to give them some body. That's why these cakes are my favorite way to eat crab! But before you go cracking any shells, stay tuned for my essential seasoning mixture...
records.translation: Mga Keyk ng Alimango/Mga Keyk ng Alimango! Malambot at walang gaanong tekstura ang laman ng alimango kapag nag-iisa, pero napakagandang paraan ang paghahalo nito sa mumo ng tinapay at itlog upang magkaroon ito ng mas magandang katawan. Kaya paborito kong paraan ng pagkain ng alimango ang mga keyk na ito! Pero bago ka magbasag ng anumang talukap, manatiling nakatutok para sa mahalaga kong timpla ng pampalasa...

records.source: Fiddlehead Risotto/Fiddlehead Risotto! Fiddlehead ferns are beautiful, but actually quite bland on their own. That's why you have to pay careful attention to the spices you add. I'll be honest, it's not very easy to make a good fiddlehead risotto. But with my help, you'll have the best chance at achieving it.
records.translation: Risotto na Pako/Risotto na Pako! Magaganda ang mga pakô, pero matabang kapag walang halo. Kaya kailangan mong maingat na piliin ang mga pampalasang idinaragdag. Aaminin ko, hindi napakadaling gumawa ng mahusay na Risotto na Pako. Pero sa tulong ko, magkakaroon ka ng pinakamagandang pagkakataong magtagumpay.

records.source: Poppyseed Muffin/Poppyseed Muffin! Poppies make beautiful ornamental flowers... but why not make full use of the plant with these delightful muffins? I'm a huge fan of poppy seeds. They're subtle, but they add a nice flavor and a great texture to bready desserts. And they're healthy!
records.translation: Muffin na Buto ng Poppy/Muffin na Buto ng Poppy! Magagandang pandekorasyong bulaklak ang mga poppy... pero bakit hindi gamitin nang buo ang halaman sa kaaya-ayang muffin na ito? Gustong-gusto ko ang mga binhi ng poppy. Banayad ang mga ito, pero nagdaragdag ng magandang lasa at mahusay na tekstura sa mga panghimagas na parang tinapay. At masustansiya pa!

records.source: Lobster Bisque/Lobster Bisque! You could serve this one to the governor himself. It's rich, creamy and delicious, with just the right amount of oceanic flavor. The hardest part is finding some lobster, but I'm sure you can do it. Heck, if you're feeling crafty you could catch one yourself with a crab pot!
records.translation: Kremang Sabaw ng Lobster/Kremang Sabaw ng Lobster! Maaari mo itong ihain mismo sa Gobernador. Malinamnam, malapot, at masarap ito, na may tamang-tamang lasa ng karagatan. Ang pinakamahirap ay humanap ng lobster, pero tiyak kong kaya mo iyon. Aba, kung malikhain ka, maaari kang makahuli nito gamit ang Bitag na Pang-alimango!

records.source: Bruschetta/Bruschetta! It's a wonderfully simple appetizer that really showcases the quality of the ingredients. You'll need bread, tomato, and oil. First, you'll need to grill the bread. Slice the tomato and place onto the grilled bread. Then drizzle with oil and serve. I told you it was simple!
records.translation: Bruschetta/Bruschetta! Napakasimple nitong pampagana na talagang itinatampok ang kalidad ng mga sangkap. Kakailanganin mo ng tinapay, kamatis, at langis. Una, ihawin ang tinapay. Hiwain ang kamatis at ilagay sa inihaw na tinapay. Pagkatapos ay patakan ng langis at ihain. Sinabi ko sa iyo, simple lang ito!

records.source: Shrimp Cocktail/Shrimp Cocktail! Here's another good appetizer for you and your dinner guests. My cocktail sauce is extra zesty, and I'm sure you'll love it. Now, the first step...
records.translation: Koktel ng Hipon/Koktel ng Hipon! Narito ang isa pang magandang pampagana para sa iyo at sa mga bisita mo sa hapunan. Matapang at maasim-asim ang lasa ng sarsang koktel ko, at tiyak kong magugustuhan mo iyon. Ngayon, ang unang hakbang...
